name: buddie
description: Check an agent's report against the sources it cites and GitHub before you rely on it.

interface.shortDescription: Check a report's quotes and PR/CI claims against their sources.
interface.longDescription: buddie checks what an agent reports: each quotation with a link is looked up in a SHA-256 snapshot of that page, and pr: and ci: anchors are checked against the GitHub API. No model takes part in the check; every check ends in a receipt (FAIL, GAPS, PASS or EMPTY) that anyone can re-run.
defaultPrompt: Verify this report with buddie before we use it.
